summary.text: Mike Motschenbacher is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives from District 47 who took office in December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

He is executive director of the ND Gaming Alliance, and in a Ballotpedia survey he named keeping taxes low, addressing the cost of higher education, and supporting first responders and the military as key messages.

paragraphs.text: Mike Motschenbacher lives in Bismarck, graduated from Washburn High School in 1990, and earned a degree in electronics technology from Bismarck State College in 1992.
His career has included working as executive director of the ND Gaming Alliance and as a general manager of Expressway Inn and Suites, and he has been affiliated with the Knights of Columbus.
He is married and has four children.

Motschenbacher advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026; the general election for the district's two seats also includes Democrats Rosann Jacobs-Fode and Cole Montoya, Republican Jon Lee, and independent Andrew Varvel.
He sits on the House Finance and Taxation and Political Subdivisions committees.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he brings a private-sector background and family values to the legislature, and that he is passionate about higher education and a low-regulation environment for businesses.
He said the state should use the Bank of North Dakota to provide low-interest student loans for North Dakota students, and he said he believes in local control.
